# Upstream pin

`vendor/ncm` is a copy of [HazyResearch/ncm](https://github.com/HazyResearch/ncm) at commit `c70274273f489abc73832b2b98584a8483b6b203`, including that repository's MIT license. No patches have been applied. The studio adapter lives outside this directory.

Model weights are not included. They are downloaded from `hazyresearch/ncm-checkpoints` at revision `d342ce8aaea58830eef3b8ad473664673e41f692` and checked before they are loaded.
